merged.title: Port 36 functions Lombyte has matched (exact, +16 KB)
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Lombyte (the matching decomp of the US build, MIT) has matched 245 functions we had not (121,756 bytes by its last published report). This PR ports the ones that carry over to PAL: **36 functions, 16,056 bytes, each an exact match** (2798 -> 2834 matched functions, matched code 19.80 % -> 20.24 %). Each port is its own commit and credits the Lombyte source file in a comment, as the earlier Lombyte ports do.

## How

- `tools/lombyte.py map`/`todo` lists what Lombyte has and we don't. Pairs whose size differs between the builds are skipped: that is different PAL code, not a port. The movie/SDK functions (`func_0023C*`-`0023E*`, `sce*`, newlib) are left out as before.
- 27 of the 36 were staged near-misses (`nonmatching/`); their staged files and README rows are removed.
- What made them match was the declarations and local-variable shape of Lombyte's version, not new tricks: `MACRO_ADDR` on scalars/arrays (retail's unsplit `lui/lw`), a MACRO_ADDR `int` read as a byte for a flag
